claim: Transfer of a locked quality-only ambiguity gate to previously unused participants under a controlled corruption design
excluded_claims: General superiority over published rejection methods

evaluation_data.name: Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions

operating_policy.features: four modality quality deficits plus largest two deficits, deficit sum and normalized deficit entropy
operating_policy.target: designed two-modality regime, not task error
operating_policy.threshold_rule: median development cross-fitted ambiguous risk; reject score >= threshold
operating_policy.retained_assertion: unique positive quality-deficit maximum; tied or zero maximum unresolved
operating_policy.final_model_artifact: Transfer model fingerprint recorded; restricted local lineage kept separately
operating_policy.quality_bounds: Fit participant-equal natural WESAD bounds on all 15 development participants; no external fitting
operating_policy.tuning_limitation: Only logistic fit is group-cross-fitted; bounds fixed using all development participants. No unbiased full-pipeline cross-validation estimate.

comparison.primary: locked learned quality gate minus quality-only
comparison.ambiguity_endpoint: false unique positive assertion on designed two-modality cases; all cases denominator
comparison.retention_endpoint: correct unique positive assertion on single-modality cases; all cases denominator
comparison.estimand: equal participant means; seeds averaged within participant
comparison.margin_justification: User accepted a pragmatic maximum loss of five percentage points before new evaluation outcomes; not an established scientific or clinical standard.
comparison.benefit_definition: Statistically supported reduction greater than zero; no universal minimum practical benefit is asserted

primary_inference.unit: participant; paired gate-minus-quality rates, seeds averaged first
primary_inference.method: Student-t mean paired-difference interval, two-sided 95 percent; approximate under independent participant sampling
primary_inference.joint_success: both criteria must pass; no success if either inconclusive or failed
primary_inference.zero_variance_rule: Use full possible difference range [-1,1]; do not claim perfect certainty
primary_inference.insufficient_participants_rule: fewer than 2 => no inference or success
primary_inference.multiple_testing: One locked comparator and conjunctive co-primary decision; no selection among methods/endpoints. Other analyses descriptive only
primary_inference.sensitivity: 10000 participant bootstrap replicates, seed 20261015; report without replacing primary result
primary_inference.assumptions: Participant independence; approximate t intervals for bounded non-normal rates. Bootstrap sensitivity does not establish exact finite-sample validity

controls.source_selection: deterministic hash selection after participant enrollment inventory, without scores or labels
controls.noise_realizations: independent, as in development; not isolated causal effect of adding second fault
controls.operator: mild additive noise with frozen development implementation
controls.source_selection_rule: Rank all complete finite nonoverlapping synchronized windows by SHA256 of protocol_id|canonical_participant|recording|start_seconds; take first 24, no quality/score/label filtering
controls.modality_design: 12 ordered distinct modality pairs, repeated twice over 24 hash-ranked sources; pair order acc,bvp,eda,temp lexical loops; single corrupts first modality, ambiguous both
controls.paired_noise: Independent noise in single versus ambiguous; match source, first modality and SNR only
controls.dtype: float32 arrays before injection, float64 noise arithmetic via existing inject_fault
controls.finite_window_rule: Exclude windows with any nonfinite input or incomplete channel; no imputation

sample_size.rationale: 36 reported stress volunteers minus two published exclusions; actual eligibility determined solely by frozen technical rules
sample_size.precision_sensitivity: At n=34, t 95 percent half-width = t(.975,33)*SD/sqrt(34). A zero true retention loss needs paired SD below roughly 0.143 for expected lower limit to exceed -0.05; this is not an 80 percent joint power guarantee

freeze_requirements: Development model and quality bounds hashed
Downloaded raw-file hash inventory verified without parsing
External timestamp of final public protocol package before evaluation
Evaluation implementation verified using synthetic inputs before real signals
public_outputs: aggregate only; raw and participant-level records remain local

preprocessing.signal_start: Parse documented UTC start per channel, align on intersection of valid record extents
preprocessing.sample_alignment: Grid starts at first common timestamp; reject channel grids offset by non-integer sample counts; no interpolation
preprocessing.rate_mismatch: Exclude recording rather than resample or tune
preprocessing.acc_units: Keep native 1/64g raw values; WESAD development pkl retains this scale. Do not divide by 64
preprocessing.normalization: None for quality-only gate; apply frozen raw-domain quality bounds
preprocessing.task_labels: Not read or used; this is controlled culprit-assignment transfer, not stress-classification validation
preprocessing.tags: Not used for outcome/source selection; no stress/rest subgroup efficacy claim

published_exclusions.criterion: Exclude duplicated-record participant and participant with covered PPG/TEMP per publisher data_constraints.txt

eligibility.canonical_participant: Strip _a/_b suffix; names are dataset-qualified, not matched to similarly named WESAD IDs
eligibility.split_records: Split records from one released participant remain grouped; never concatenate across recording gaps
eligibility.insufficient_complete_windows: Exclude participant if fewer than 24 after predetermined technical validity checks; retain reason
eligibility.participant_overlap_evidence: Separate published cohorts; matching pseudonymous codes across datasets do not imply same person. Direct individual identity matching is unavailable
eligibility.prior_project_use: No matching source/name/DOI in searched local manifests/docs; not independently audited proof
eligibility.intended_population: eligible released stress-session cohort only; convenience cohort, not general wearable population

public_package_note: Contains design and aggregate metadata only; no raw signals or participant-level results. Prepared locally, not uploaded or preregistered.

implementation_specification.timestamp_serialization: nine digits after decimal in source/noise SHA token
implementation_specification.primary_ci_bounds: Clip t intervals to possible participant difference range [-1,1]
